description: A form section for updating the user's email address. Displays the current email and provides an input for the new email. Native form elements provide built-in semantics.

keyboard.action: Navigates between the email input and action buttons
Submits the form when a field or the submit button is focused

focus.notes: Focus follows natural tab order through the input and buttons. Focus ring uses standard ring styling.

announcements: The current email is presented as static text
The new email input is announced with its associated label
Action buttons are announced as their visible text

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for all text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure onSubmit validates the new email and communicates result to the user
Provide error messaging for invalid email formats
